blocks.text: Plain grey wings, more elytra than bird. Every legend starts somewhere.
Owning this pair also adds a small bonus to every stat of your collection: Endurance +0.31, Acceleration +6.01, Speed +0.39, Handling +0.44, Stability +1.03, glide +1.86, lift +2.59.
At the Assembly Table, join leather, an elytra and two feathers. No Cloud Essence needed.
This pair can also be summoned at the Draconic Altar
